title: The Note in the Pump Manual
prompt: Anika put a stained 1986 pump-station manual on the table. In pencil beside a valve sequence, an operator had written: ‘Ignore this in rain. Valve sticks.’
current_summary: A pencil warning in a pump manual led the founders through stains, missing notes fields, two deferred $43.20 gasket requests, eleven rain shutdowns, and the absent night-shift operator who knew the workaround.
